title: Ring tool undo/redo stack: multi-level Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Shift+Z over anchor and ring edits
description:
User review 2026-10-03 of the CRAW-30 ring tool (authored and supporting anchors, drafts); builds on CRAW-30's baseline. The user's 17 saved fertility rings (fixtures/fertility_rings.dsl: ring_candidates plus spline_ring ring_05 to ring_17) must survive the change and reload element-exact.

A real undo/redo stack for the ring tool, replacing CRAW-30's one-level Ctrl+Z. Ctrl+Z steps back through every edit; Ctrl+Shift+Z (and Ctrl+Y) redoes; a new edit after an undo drops the redo tail. An edit is one anchor add, one anchor delete, one whole drag (press to release), one ring delete, one draft confirm. The stack covers ring-level edits, not only anchor edits inside one draft, so confirming a draft or deleting a ring (the ring-delete ticket) can be undone. It lives in memory for the tool session; a save does not clear it. ui-state exposes the undo and redo depths.
definition-of-done: 1. On fertility with the saved rings, Ctrl+Z steps back through at least five mixed edits (anchor add, drag, anchor delete, confirm, and ring delete if that ticket has landed) one at a time, and Ctrl+Shift+Z replays them. 2. A new edit after an undo clears redo. 3. ui-state reports the undo and redo depths. 4. Build checkstyle-green.
testing-plan: 1. Unit test on the stack: push, undo, redo, branch. 2. Automation sequence through the /input routes with screenshots in tmp/ after each step.
changes-made: Design: new scenes.ring.EditHistory<S>, a generic whole-state undo/redo stack (parallel lists editNames/statesBefore/statesAfter, undoDepth cursor, push drops the redo tail, capacity 256 drops the oldest), and scenes.ring.RingToolState, the memento of everything an edit can change (confirmed-ring lists, draft spline/anchors/base normal/source ring/source label/trace depth, converted graph labels; splines shared, not copied, so restore is exact with no re-trace). RingTool.history replaces undoAuthoredVertexId; every edit captures a state before and pushes (before, after) through recordEdit when anything changed: draft opened, ring re-opened, graph ring converted, anchor added, anchor deleted, anchor dragged (whole press-to-release, captured at grab, pushed on release), draft confirmed, draft dropped (Esc / finish / last anchor deleted). A ring delete (CRAW-35) is the same three lines: capture RingToolState, remove the row, recordEdit("ring deleted", before). Saves do not touch the history; a model switch clears it. Statement ids and unsaved flags are re-derived on restore from what this session's saves wrote (savedStatementByRing, savedAuthoredByStatement, savedNormalByStatement), so a redo past a save keeps ring_NN and an undo past a save marks the ring unsaved. Keys: Ctrl+Z undo, Ctrl+Shift+Z and Ctrl+Y redo (ControlHint.shiftHeld + OrbitCameraKeyGuy.MOD_SHIFT; the shift hint is listed before plain Ctrl+Z). ui-state ringTool: undoDepth, redoDepth, nextUndo, nextRedo (draft.undoAvailable removed).

Verified 2026-10-03 on launch entry 'CRAW-34: Ring undo/redo (fertility copy)' (ixdar.model=../tmp/fertility_work.dsl, a copy; tracked fixture sha256 unchanged, 18 graph rings load). tmp/craw34_sequence.sh: eight mixed edits (draft opened a46db3b4fd980802, anchor added 564f1be1158db51f, anchor dragged 87831421dec7a93e, anchor deleted a46db3b4fd980802, anchor added b712a72273dfe035, confirm -> ring 18, graph ring_05 converted 5bd54f975bf0dd57, confirm -> ring 19), Ctrl+S on the copy (ring_18, ring_19 appended), undoDepth 8. tmp/craw34_undo_redo.sh: Ctrl+Z eight times steps back one edit at a time with every draft and ring fingerprint equal to the forward pass, a ninth reports nothing to undo; Ctrl+Shift+Z / Ctrl+Y alternating replays all eight, rings come back as ring_18/ring_19 saved. tmp/craw34_branch.sh: two undos then a new draft -> redoDepth 0, Ctrl+Shift+Z refused. tmp/craw34_save_undo.sh: re-open ring_18, add an anchor (106 edges 2981700483c9ca6d), confirm, save (1 rewritten), Ctrl+Z restores the 50-edge ring_18 marked unsaved (the copy holds the 106-edge shape). Screenshots tmp/craw34_00_start.png .. tmp/craw34_70_reconfirm_changed.png. Unit: EditHistoryTest 6/6 (push, undo, redo, branch, capacity, clear); full suite 340 run, 0 failures; mvn -q compile clean (checkstyle green).

Left open: undoing the confirm of a ring that a save already appended leaves its statement in the working .dsl (saves only append or rewrite; removing statements is CRAW-35's ring-delete work). Confirming a re-opened ring back to exactly its saved shape still reports unsaved (CRAW-30's conservative confirm flag; the next save rewrites identical text). The fertility launch via ixdar.model opens at orbit distance 3.5 (camera not framed); the scripts set distance 268.5 first. The launch entry's property was first written as tmp/fertility_work.dsl (resolves under ixdar-app/); launch-add has no replace, so that one value was corrected in place to ../tmp/fertility_work.dsl.
